title: Publish HYB-007 Z-app comparison (candidate)
body: ## Summary Candidate behavior comparison of `Zz/artifacts/z-app` against current TESSERA. The page ports ideas only: no second app, no auth/database/migration/runtime copy, and no TESSERA code changes. Published page: `merge/hyb-007-z-app.md`, linked from `SUMMARY.md` and the functional merge matrix. HYB-007 is marked DONE (analysis published). Moderator/Father seal is still outstanding. ## Constraints honored - Ideas only. The TanStack Start shell, better-auth, PGlite/Kysely migrations, Nitro/Vercel contract, generated packet, and `data/` runtime stay in `Zz`. - `1T` was not inspected, copied, or opened. The proof rotator that names `1T` is rejected. - No code changes to TESSERA. This PR edits Gitbook docs only. - Draft. Do not merge. ## Sources - `vitalitychems-dot/Zz` `main` @ `150d4ec044201ae5d43878da38c7bd7788c3ac2a` - `vitalitychems-dot/TESSERA` `main` @ `fec56eb09d19907832663d5f16fcbc24f3d00317` ## Disposition counts ACCEPTED 4 · RETAINED 4 · REJECTED 20 · NEEDS-EVIDENCE 0 Z10 is RETAINED (HYB-013). A line-level comparison shows own-lab has no behavioral overlap with theorem-lab or CompressionLab, so it stays in Zz until it has a named TESSERA target, a test, and a rollback. Zz paths named on the retained rows: - Z9: `artifacts/z-app/src/lib/tessera/colonel.ts` - Z10: `artifacts/z-app/src/lib/tessera/own-lab.ts` - Z14: `artifacts/z-app/src/lib/tessera/world.ts` Issue #2 should carry these corrected counts. A follow-up comment is posted on that issue. ## Checks Opened the z-app shell and the cited behavior modules, then read `theorem-lab.ts` and `CompressionLabPage.tsx` against `own-lab.ts`. Enumerated TESSERA pages, libs, API routes, and scripts at the SHAs above. No installs. No `1T` inspection. `imports/objects`, held-packet, study-log, father-profile, and `data/**` bodies were left unread. Head: `580a3dc3066a00f20b5bf9f892f5cc52744f4753`

title: Publish Ready GitBook batches 003–009 (GB-004 through GB-014)
body: ## Summary Lands the Ready GitBook pack for batches 003–009 (GB-004 through GB-014) on the private docs repo. Batches were applied in order so later files supersede earlier ones. Batch READMEs stayed out of the tree; they were the apply guides, not the site home. - **GB-004** — Open Helper Agent 2 (`mesh/roles/open-helper-agent-2.md`) - **GB-005** — published-status delta on Tessera Pen and the pen tone guide - **GB-006** — Pen ability set framing - **GB-007–009** — who Tessera is, refuse and offer, Board / World / Chamber - **GB-010** — Build corrected to verify-only (supersedes the provisional page from `ffc2b87`) - **GB-011–013** — pen-gate refuse companion, honesty banner, mesh lane map - **GB-014** — mesh lane map publish-path delta (Father pushes GitBook → GitHub; Replit out of this path) `SUMMARY.md`, `mesh/roles.md`, and `intake/log.md` match batch 009. Existing pages the pack does not replace (`mesh/flow.md`, `review/`, `.gitbook.yaml`, and the other role pages) are unchanged. ## Test plan - [x] Applied batches 003 → 009 in order and confirmed tip files match batch 009 - [x] Every `SUMMARY.md` link resolves to a file in the repo - [x] Relative links in the changed markdown resolve - [ ] Merge to `main` so the published tip includes GB-004 through GB-014
